caption: The drawing depicts a single object—a bonnet—rendered in grayscale tones ranging from light gray to deep black. The bonnet is positioned at an angle with its rounded crown facing left and the opening, framed by a narrow, defined edge, facing right. Attached to the lower right side of the bonnet is a large, wide ribbon, tied in a bow, with two long ends trailing and curling outward toward the bottom and left edges of the composition. The shading emphasizes the smooth texture and curvature of the fabric, as well as the folds and flow of the ribbons. The background is plain and unadorned, in a lighter shade, allowing the bonnet and ribbon to stand out prominently.
title: Sunbonnet
